8(12.000) + 15(1.00783) + 14.003 + 15.995 = 96 + 15.117 + 14.003 + 15.995 = 141.115 ✓

This matches! So the molecular formula is likely C8H15NO.

DBE of 2 suggests 2 degrees of unsaturation (could be 2 double bonds, 1 ring + 1 double bond, or 2 rings).
